title: reconsider settles in one run
line: the relatives an obituary names, taken by the rule when the owner accepts its subject (the parents on the relationships it states, the brothers and sisters it names created), are taken back and put to the rule again by reconsider: one run takes every one of them again, and a second run changes nothing: no decision withdrawn, no card taken, no resolution taken back, not one audit row written

steps.say: his obituary, the file's own citation, naming his parents, brothers and sisters, children and grandchildren
its subject accepted by the owner: the rule takes the relatives the obituary states, and the cards it does not take wait for the owner

expect.why: his mother, the relationship the obituary states to him on the tree's own link
a brother nobody in the tree fits, created
the subject by the owner, twelve relatives by the rule
the rest wait for the owner; the pastor it relates to him only as "Other Relative" is nobody to create, a hint and no card
the harness tree's thirty and the nine brothers and sisters the rule created

steps.say: the rule takes its decisions on the obituary back: each relative is a card for the owner again

expect.why: the owner's own decision on the subject stands

steps.say: reconsider: the rule takes every one of them again, the created brothers and sisters linking the persons they were

expect.why: nothing it decided is left to examine: the cards were all undecided
a run that decides writes: an audit row for each of the twelve
the same thirteen as before the withdrawal
no second person for a brother or sister taken again: the nine the first creation made

steps.say: reconsider again: every decision it made is examined on the ground that stood before it and kept, no card is taken or refused anew, and nothing is written

expect.why: a run that changes nothing writes nothing: not a decision, a link, a statement, a question or an audit row
no decision withdrawn, no resolution taken back
no card taken, no older card proposed again, no conflict resolved
